messages.content: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

message.content: Stephen, you’ve been one of the **best engineers** on the team, and your memes brought just as much joy as your code. We’ll miss your talent, your humor, and the energy you brought every day—go build amazing things and keep the memes coming!
